g.text: VCC BUCK: starts at 8 V. Firmware must set 10 V through the internal power-management interface after every VM return.

g.desc: VCC BUCK: starts at 8 V. Firmware must set 10 V through the internal power-management interface after every VM return.

g.text: SCREF approx. 0.30 V controls VDS fault detection; it is not a precision current limit. Configure COMP1/2/4 + DAC + TIM1 break before enabling PWM.

g.desc: SCREF approx. 0.30 V controls VDS fault detection; it is not a precision current limit. Configure COMP1/2/4 + DAC + TIM1 break before enabling PWM.

g.text: Pin 64 REGIN and pin 1 REG3V3/VDD are both tied to external 3V3. The internal 3V3 regulator stays disabled.

g.desc: Pin 64 REGIN and pin 1 REG3V3/VDD are both tied to external 3V3. The internal 3V3 regulator stays disabled.

g.text: PB8/BOOT0 has a 10k pulldown. FEEDBACK_ENABLE_N is pulled high, so the mux cannot drive PB8 while reset is active.

g.desc: PB8/BOOT0 has a 10k pulldown. FEEDBACK_ENABLE_N is pulled high, so the mux cannot drive PB8 while reset is active.

g.text: ERC sources: connector input / passive-filtered regulator outputs / internal bootstrap supplies.
